I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked at 1280px.

- **Layout:** the page is white and the content is one centered column, 1120px max. The "Approvals" heading is Unbounded Light in capitals, with "3 waiting for you" below it. Each of the three items is a card showing title, requester, amount, "Approve" and "Decline".
- **Buttons:** DESIGN.md allows one primary button per screen, and this screen has no single main action. So "Approve" is the Secondary style (1.5px ink outline) and "Decline" is the Quiet style (no fill, no border). Both are 44px pills.
- **Tokens:** the file inlines only the tokens it uses, so it's self-contained. It has no raw hex values outside that token block.
- **Fonts:** no font files are in the folder, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to `system-ui` unless they're installed locally.

I left out a top-right primary action because you asked for exactly this content. `session.json` was empty and `session.err` only held a model-name log line, so neither affected the build.
